title: Emulators for Large-scale Computer Experiments with Quantitative and Qualitative Inputs
abstract: Computer experiments with both quantitative and qualitative inputs have become common across various areas. However, constructing accurate and computationally efficient emulators for such experiments at large scales remains a significant challenge. We propose a novel, scalable framework for emulating computer experiments with mixed inputs. Our approach is based on a new covariance function integrating additive Gaussian Processes (GPs) to handle the mixed inputs, with Vecchia approximation for scalability. We demonstrate that methods for large-scale computer experiments can be effectively extended when paired with our proposed modeling framework.
